detail.longDescription: It's also important to autoscale your autoscaler (heehehhehehehhehehe) They did this at stripe in the following ways: - tuning the KEDA controller concurrency - metric caching instead of overwhelming prometheus with queries - higher-tier workloads get faster performance from the KEDA controllers (I'd love to know how they do this, I didn't quite catch it) - profile/tune your scale (e.g., they built a temporal scaler because the upstream one wasn’t performant enough for their use cases) # kubecon # kubernetes # k8s # keda
